name: inkwell-realtime-hub
description: Minimal WebSocket push service for real-time collaboration notifications — a "something changed, go refetch" ping mechanism, not a CRDT/op-log sync layer. Server-to-server callers (the Next.js app, after a real mutation) authenticate with a shared bearer secret; individual browser/desktop clients authenticate per-subscribe with a short-lived signed token proving they actually have access to the projectId they're subscribing to.
